items.title: Domino's Pizza (DPZ) Stock Looks Above Fair Value Even As Growth Expands
items.summary: Domino's Pizza has seen its share price move around in recent years, and the question now is whether the current US$361.53 level can be backed up by the cash the business is expected to generate. With sentiment also shaped by legal scrutiny and growth efforts overseas, the key issue for you is how firmly those cash flows support today's valuation.
